primary_findings.quote: Higher adherence to the Mediterranean diet was associated with lower risk of all-cause mortality (0.74, 95%CI: 0.65-0.84), cardiovascular mortality (0.84, 95%CI: 0.75-0.94), and recurrent cardiovascular events (0.60, 95%CI: 0.39-0.92).
